# Lib.volume.generate

## Operators

- [**FieldToVolume**](FieldToVolume.md) — Samples a CPU scalar field into a sparse grid over a box region.
- [**VolumeFromMesh**](VolumeFromMesh.md) — Converts a mesh into a sparse volume, either a signed distance field or a fog density.
- [**VolumeFromPoints**](VolumeFromPoints.md) — Splats a point list into a sparse density volume.
- [**VolumePrimitive**](VolumePrimitive.md) — Generates an analytic primitive as a narrow-band level set volume.
